title: Read系deny ruleがコマンドのファイルアクセス予測を過大近似し、自動承認モードでも読み取り専用Bashを毎回ブロックして自律実行を破壊する
summary: Claude Code 2.1.257-2.1.259 regression cluster (>=10 independent issues, 2026-09-01..09-04, top 56 +1): the mere presence of any Read() deny rule arms a conservative cd-compound/search guard that prompts on read-only Bash (cd+grep/rg/sed, rg on stdin, grep --include) even in auto mode, bypassPermissions, and headless runs; the predicate ignores the deny rule's own patterns and gives up on statically-resolvable absolute paths when ';' appears. Distinct from catalog G17 (chronic fatigue) and P-20260831-60EFB5BF (false-allow direction): this is the false-deny dual — over-approximated access prediction makes deny rules incompatible with autonomous operation and cascades approval requests through subagents. Key issues: anthropics/claude-code#91650, #91683, #91776, #91784, #91853, #91681, #91848, #91778, #91837, #91751.
proposed_category: I/G: 権限判定の静的解析（deny-rule到達可能性の過大近似による可用性障害）

evidence.title: [BUG] Bash cd-compound-read guard prompts on absolute cd targets whenever a Read() deny rule exists (2.1.257-2.1.259)
evidence.summary: 56 +1; resolver gives up on ';' in compounds even with absolute literal cd targets; persists headless; cascades through subagents.

evidence.title: bypassPermissions mode now prompts on `cd DIR && grep` when a Read() deny rule is configured (regression in 2.1.259)
evidence.summary: 26 +1; bypassPermissions no longer bypasses when any Read() deny rule exists.

evidence.title: Read() deny rule arms an unwhitelistable cd+relative-read prompt in bypassPermissions (2.1.257+), and the predicate ignores the rule's patterns
evidence.summary: 7 +1; guard fires regardless of whether the command could touch the denied patterns; prompt cannot be allowlisted away.

evidence.title: [BUG] Regression in 2.1.259: rg reading stdin in a pipeline is treated as a search of '.' and prompts (auto mode bypassed) when a Read() deny rule covers a file under the cwd
evidence.summary: Misclassification example: stdin-only rg treated as directory search of cwd.

evidence.title: `grep -r` with `--include` filters falsely triggers `Read(.env)` deny prompt (v2.1.259) — breaks every recursive search
evidence.summary: 7 +1; include filters that cannot match the denied file still trigger the prompt, breaking all recursive search.
